about: The card's source reading of every baseline leak leaf the witness alone does not decide (a clean witness path exists). Read against the pinned sources under build/cycle19/c-gateway-wave-pin/fluent-bit-clang-source at revision 66910c10. A function entry applies to all its leaves unless a leaf entry (FUNCTION@EXIT@ACQUIRED) overrides it. Class (a): reading confirms the witness path is reachable under the stated premises and the resource is really unreleased on it. Class (c): the accusation rests on a named premise or approximation the projection cannot see past; it stays provisional. No class is an upstream defect claim.

premises.REFUSED-CALL-ARGUMENT-PREMISE: An identity handed, as a value or an interior address, to a call the projection refuses is assumed neither released nor retained by that call. The accusation stands only if that is so; it is false for the destructors and list/TLS/iov/ring-buffer/thread insertions named below.
premises.MK-LIST-ADD-BORROWED-PUBLICATION: mk_list_add is declared resource_borrowed on both parameters (providers/qcore-provider-libevent/contracts/monkey/intrusive_list.qcore). Linking `&obj->_head` into a list reachable from the caller publishes `obj`, which a borrowed position does not state, so the accusation after the insertion rests on the declaration's silence about publication.
premises.PATH-INSENSITIVE-SCALAR-CORRELATION: The projection does not correlate branches on scalar values (a flag, a loop pass counter, a re-validation of the same input), so a witness may combine branch outcomes no execution combines.
premises.NULL-TEST-UNDECIDED-AFTER-POISONED-JOIN: A null test of a binding that a refused statement on another path poisoned is undecided (UnknownAlias on the test), so its null edge keeps the site live although on that edge the allocation failed.
premises.DESTINATION-SUFFIX-PLACE-SPELLING: direct_assignment_destination spells a destination by its first suffix that is a canonical place, so `(*map)->opts = calloc(...)` binds the local-looking place `opts`; the store into the caller's `*map` is not seen.
premises.CHAINED-ASSIGNMENT-INNER-DESTINATION: `d = safe = rd_malloc(n)` binds the call's result to the outer destination `d` only; `safe`, which the function returns, stays unbound, so the return escapes nothing.
